hook: 差集 V 專場開在V勝利台——沒進幽默庫的詞排隊檢票。
script: vaciliate／vacillate／vacillation／vagary／vaguary／vainglorious 先檢票。其餘 orphan 接龍。檢票員：同字母只是入口，不是同義證；名牌上的中文才是身份證。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English

members.speakLineZh: 請「V席」出場：vaciliate 一上場梗就黏住——猶豫；躊躇。
